thread:
maria: quick heads up from registration QA: two different confirmation emails were sent when I signed up via the embed (one from Zoom + one from our Marketing webhook). customers will get confused.

sam: ugh, thanks. saw dupes in the test leads too. what's the embed using—Zoom native register + our postback?

maria: yes: Zoom registration enabled on the embed and we also trigger a Zap when a new registrant hits HubSpot. Zap is creating a Contact and sending our designed confirmation.

tony: we should de-dupe at Zapier: only send the marketing confirmation if the Zoom webhook payload doesn't include "confirmed": true OR if "source" != "zoom_embed".

zoombot: Zoom webhook event received: registration.completed (id: 999-aaa). registrant email: qa+1@redwood.test

maria: proposed quick fix: edit Zap filter to require `zap.meta.source == "forms_embed"` (our hosted form) or add a 3s delay and check HubSpot for existing engagement. not ideal but fast.

sam: alternative: disable Zoom confirmation emails (Settings > Email > Registration) and let our marketing email be the single truth. ops dependency though.

ops-bot: Reminder: changing Zoom account email settings requires admin approval. submit ticket: #ticket-2026-0423.

tony: plan: 1) disable Zoom confirmation for this webinar (if approved) 2) add Zap filter to exclude zoom_embed events 3) add a lightweight banner to our confirmation that says "If you also received Zoom's email, ignore it". owners: sam (Zoom admin ticket), maria (copy + banner), tony (Zap filter).

maria: also accessibility check: ensure our confirmation email includes an accessible link to the on-demand player with captions toggled on by default and an SRT download link. we had a complaint last event about missing captions on embeds.

sam: noted. Zoom player embed supports `?cc=1` param for captions on by default for our player widget. we'll add that to the replay link.

tony: Zap mapping note : add property `webinar_source` = "embed" and `utm_campaign` = "march_launch_v1" on contact creation so analytics can segment.

maria: post-event follow-up cadence suggestion: Day0 immediate confirmation + replay + captions + calendar invite added; Day2 short clip (benchmark highlight) + CTA; Day6 product email with case study + book a demo CTA. sync with demand gen for frequency.

zoombot: Recording processed: meeting 999-aaa. Files: cloud_mp4, cloud_vtt, transcript.txt uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/tmp/999-aaa/

sam: closing loop for tonight: submitted admin ticket for Zoom email toggle, disabled duplicate Zap action on test, and added Zap filter. I'll post screenshots in the ticket.

maria: thanks all. i'll update the event brief and add the CC-on-by-default param to the replay URLs. will follow up tomorrow about the final confirmation copy. :white_check_mark:
